messages.subject: Multigroup for polytomous and multidimensional
parts:
Hi everybody, 

I'm running a model where I have 15 items in 4 dimensions an a variable "group" with groupe D1 and D2. 

models2 <- mirt.model('
   F1 = 1-3
   F2 = 4-7
   F3 = 9-12
   F4= 8, 13-15')

mod_configural2 <- multipleGroup(dat, models2, group = group)


plot(mod_configural2, type = 'infocontour')
plot(mod_configural2, type = 'SE')
plot(mod_configural2, type = 'RE')
itemplot(mod_configural2, 10)


I would like to make the following graphs, but i've the following error " Error: length of the degrees vector not equal to the number of factors"

Do you think i have to separate my items and run 4 differents models : 
mod1 <- mirt.model('
   F1 = 1-3')

mod2- mirt.model(' 
   F2 = 4-7')

mod2- mirt.model(' 
   F3 = 9-12')

mod2- mirt.model(' 
   F4= 8, 13-15')

And after i run separately all the plot for each model ? 

Thank you for your response,

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Multigroup for polytomous and multidimensional
parts:
This approach is fine as your MIRT model doesn't contain any borrowed information across the factors anyway, so there's no harm in take subsets of the items and fitting unidimensional models instead. 

Phil
